notes: Duelist Kingdom character lists. Anime-faithful 40-card TCG approximations using cards_db. Missing anime cards are noted per deck.

characters.name: Yugi Mutou · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Grandpa's deck: Dark Magician, Gaia fusion, Kuriboh, Magical Hats. Closest TCG 40 to the island list.

characters.name: Yugi Mutou · Forbidden One
characters.notes: Kaiba-match Exodia. Five pieces at 1. Heart of the Underdog + stall. Witch of the Black Forest omitted (forbidden).

characters.name: Seto Kaiba · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Three Blue-Eyes, Battle Ox, La Jinn, Lord of D. / Flute. Crush Card Virus is not in the DB.

characters.name: Joey Wheeler · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Red-Eyes, Time Wizard, Baby Dragon, Flame Swordsman / Thousand Dragon. Alligator's Sword and Kunai with Chain are not in the DB.

characters.name: Mai Valentine · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Harpie Ladies, Elegant Egotist, Pet Dragon, Sisters. Cyber Shield is not in the DB.

characters.name: Weevil Underwood · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Petit Moth + Cocoon into Great Moth / Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth. Eradicating Aerosol is not in the DB.

characters.name: Rex Raptor · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Sword Arm of Dragon, Megazowler, Trakodon, Little D are not in the DB. King Rex / Uraby / Raise Body Heat carry it.

characters.name: Mako Tsunami · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Fortress Whale and Fiend Kraken are not in the DB. Umi + Legendary Fisherman; Orca Mega-Fortress stands in for the whale.

characters.name: Maximillion Pegasus · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Toon World + Toon bosses, Relinquished. Toon Table of Contents and Shadow Toon are not in the DB.

characters.name: Yami Bakura · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: White Magical Hat, Man-Eater Bug, fiends. Change of Heart omitted (forbidden). Dark Energy + Goblin Fan keep the dirty-spell flavor.

characters.name: Bonz · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Pumpking and the graveyard zombies. Clown Zombie is not in the DB; Yaranzo and Magical Ghost fill that slot.

characters.name: PaniK · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Castle of Dark Illusions. Barox, Dark Chimera, and Metal Guardian are not in the DB; King of Yamimakai / Reaper of the Cards stand in.

characters.name: Paradox Brothers · Duelist Kingdom
characters.notes: Sanga, Kazejin, Suijin into Gate Guardian. Dungeon Worm is not in the DB.

characters.name: Bandit Keith · Duelist Kingdom
